title: Founder school invitation
description: A founder reviews school access and issues an invitation for the correct institution.

intents.title: Invite a principal or teacher
intents.actor: platform founder or authorized school founder
intents.outcome: Connect a verified person to the correct institution.

journeys.title: Review and invite
journeys.situation: A founder receives a request to connect a principal or teacher and must review the institution and their authority before issuing an invitation.
journeys.outcome: Connect a verified person to the correct institution.

existingBehavior: An invitation repository and native invitation interface exist; issuance and redemption require end-to-end verification.
invariants: A message or claimed role never grants access.
A founder may only invite within their verified authority.
openQuestions: Verify the database invitation redemption function, founder issuance, revocation and recipient binding.

steps.title: Review school access
steps.interaction: Review the contact and identify the correct school and recipient.

steps.title: Invitation issued
steps.interaction: Share an invitation scoped to the school and intended capacity.

transitions.title: Issue an invitation
transitions.action: An authorized founder issues an invitation.
transitions.feedback: Show its school, capacity and expiry.

scenarios.title: Founder invites a principal
scenarios.expected: An authorized invitation is issued for the correct school; acceptance remains subject to server verification.

requirements.title: Server-verified authority
requirements.statement: Only authorized founders issue invitations; only server-verified acceptance creates school authority.

bindings.title: School invite repository
bindings.note: Client implementation exists; the database function and full security properties remain unverified.
